metadata.title: Hard Rock Leather and Steel Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A gritty hard rock aesthetic featuring a black leather jacket with embroidered lettering resting against industrial red metal and diamond plate textures.
triggerTerms: hard rock album cover with obi strip

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a black leather jacket draped over the interior of a red industrial vehicle, featuring bold embroidered typography and a vertical information strip on the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Black leather texture against red industrial metal
Diagonal placement of the jacket creating dynamic movement
Vertical information strip contrasting with the organic folds of the leather
Warm yellow and red accents against dark shadows
coreInvariants: Industrial textures like diamond plate and weathered red paint
Bold, blocky typography with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The leather jacket is the central subject, filling the middle and right thirds of the frame at a large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow and red embroidered text on the jacket acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vertical obi strip on the left, moves down the diagonal line of the jacket, and rests on the embroidered patch.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with textures and mechanical details.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows against low-value, desaturated blacks and grays.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block serifs on display text
Strong outer strokes or 'glow' effects to separate text from dark backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters on the jacket are warped to follow the folds of the leather
Vertical text on the obi strip is rotated 90 degrees
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for the main title paired with condensed sans-serif for technical metadata.

preserve: The diagonal orientation of the jacket text
The vertical layout of the left-side information bar

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif feel of the main title.
Suitable for the condensed metadata on the obi strip.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a black leather biker jacket draped over the red interior of a vintage fire truck, showing diamond plate flooring and industrial textures with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical black strip on the left with white and yellow condensed text. Add large, yellow slab-serif text diagonally across the jacket, warped to match the leather folds, with a red outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket text warped to follow the fabric?
Is the left-side strip strictly vertical?
Are the colors limited to red, yellow, black, and silver?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red metal weathering
Angle of the jacket's diagonal placement
Width of the vertical obi strip
mustRedesign: Exact skull illustration on the patch
postGenerationChecks: Check that the leather looks realistic and not plastic.
Ensure the red metal has a weathered, industrial feel.
Verify the text on the jacket appears embroidered rather than just printed.
Confirm the vertical strip does not obscure the main subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Red + Black Leather + Diagonal Slab-Serif + Vertical Metadata Strip = Hard Rock Aesthetic
